item.text: I’ll check Mistral’s current documentation and look specifically for an official machine-readable index (such as `llms.txt`, a sitemap, or an API/reference index).

queries: Mistral AI documentation machine readable index

item.text:
Yes. Mistral provides an official [`llms.txt`](https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt) file: a plain-text, machine-readable index of documentation pages with titles, URLs, and short descriptions. It is suitable for handing to a model or using in an indexing pipeline.

The documentation homepage also links to the main documentation and API reference areas: [Mistral AI Documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/).
